player_prompt.intro:
Uwite Umukino {player_id} ukina igikino ca Damas nkaho {color}.
Wahamishe mu kugeza kwa noti yo mu maji [fileRank fileRank], b.f. '[b2c3]' (akarere kabiri a–h, nambari yintamu 0–7).
Ibishushanyo bya nyuma:
  • Kuhamisha kuguru kwa 1 ikiwa kirimo.
  • Gukwata kwa kuzinduka ku kipepe kiwacu.
  • Kipepe kizwi kuwa Kinge ikiye kugeza hejuru yacyo.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nta kugeza ibarurisho ryoroshye ryahawe. Urabikorere [a1b2], b.f. [b2c3].
